activity_statements.statement: franchises and manages hotels across 22+ brands including Hilton Hotels & Resorts, Hampton by Hilton, DoubleTree, Waldorf Astoria, Conrad, Curio Collection, Tapestry, Canopy, and LXR Hotels
operates Hilton Honors, a loyalty program giving members points redeemable across the global hotel portfolio

opens new hotels globally — including recent properties in Turkey, Vietnam, Ireland, Southeast Asia, Malaysia, Florida Keys, and Hawaii — primarily through franchise and management contract structures rather than property ownership
operates a capital-light asset model where Hilton earns management fees and franchise royalties rather than owning hotel real estate
operates the Hilton Honors mobile app enabling room upgrades, digital check-in, and reward booking across properties worldwide

name_reality_gap: Hilton looks like a hotel company but it is primarily a franchise and brand management company — most Hilton properties are owned by independent investors who pay franchise fees and management fees to Hilton. This means Hilton is primarily a software, brand, and revenue-management operator, not a real estate company.
extraction_notes: Hilton's main website pages returned Akamai JS shells. Newsroom provided brand portfolio and recent openings evidence. Specific property count (around 7,000+ globally) not directly extracted but widely documented. No 10-K retrieved directly.
